app.name: ChampHub
app.tagline: Book a ground, fill your match, build your game.

home.heading: Your game is on tonight
home.body: Book a ground near you, fill the empty spots with players at your level, and keep a record worth showing.
home.heroNote: Held for two hours while you confirm. Nothing to install.
home.sportsBody: Your rating is per sport, so a cricketer is not judged by their football.
home.step1Body: Pick a turf, a date and a slot. Pay cash at the turf or online, whichever you prefer.
home.step2Body: Leave your match open and players nearby ask to join, or bring your own squad.
home.step3Body: Enter the scorecard, pick a man of the match, and everyone's rating moves.
home.ownerBody: Take bookings, sell at the counter, track stock and get paid — in one place.
